Thank you for reviewing Hearth Room.

WHAT HEARTH IS
Hearth Room is the Mac client for PrivateClaw, an open-source, invite-only, end-to-end encrypted chat system for small trusted circles and a self-hosted AI assistant. PrivateClaw has two parts:
1. A free desktop component (Windows/macOS/Linux) that runs on the user's own computer next to the AI assistant runtime of their choice. It creates rooms and issues one-time QR invites.
2. Hearth Room (this app), which joins one of those rooms from a Mac and sends messages, photos, voice notes, and files.
No account, sign-up, subscription, or third-party login is involved. Messages are end-to-end encrypted; the relay only ever sees ciphertext plus delivery metadata.

HOW TO TEST - READY-TO-USE INVITES (attached)
Attached to this submission: hearth-app-review-pairing-0.1.20.zip, containing two invites, each as text and as a QR image:
- direct-pairing.txt / direct-pairing-qr.png  (one-to-one room, the default flow)
- group-pairing.txt / group-pairing-qr.png    (group room; scan it on two devices or installs to see shared-room behaviour)
In the Mac app, open the saved QR image (or paste the invite text). The invites are valid until 2026-12-24. If a session nears expiry during review, use the in-app renew control or send /renew-session.

Direct invite URI:
privateclaw://connect?

Group invite URI:
privateclaw://connect?

WALKTHROUGH VIDEO - how the desktop side works
Rooms are created by the desktop component, so the Mac app needs an invite before it can open a room. This recording shows the real flow end to end (desktop component creates the room -> iPhone joins -> messages flow both ways, encrypted):
https://github.com/topcheer/PrivateClaw/releases/download/review-demo/hearth-v1/hearth-app-review-walkthrough.mp4
The desktop component is free and open source: https://github.com/topcheer/PrivateClaw (Windows build on the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P12LL1LT8RD). Privacy policy: https://privateclaw.us/privacy/

If you would like a live invite for this build, reply through App Store Connect review messaging and we will provide a fresh one within a few hours (it can be made permanent for review).

WHAT'S NEW IN 0.1.21
This version refreshes the app's user experience only: a first-run guide, step-wise connection progress with Cancel, readable connection errors, a dedicated session panel with a Renew button, grouped messages with date separators, and a composer that only shows actions that work in the current state. No new account, purchase, data collection, or permission is involved.
